rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something tangible or perceptible by touch, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: This fabric is tactile, not just nice to look at.
example.traditional: 呢塊布摸得到，唔係淨係睇落去靚。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 bou3 mo2 dak1 dou3 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 tai2 lok6 heoi3 leng3

rows.note: Use this noun as a modifier when describing something relating to the sense of touch, such as a 觸覺錯覺.

example.english: This game puts a lot of emphasis on tactile experience.
example.traditional: 呢個遊戲好重視觸覺體驗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 zung6 si6 zuk1 gok3 tai2 jim6
